prompt: Build a task management app for small teams. Users sign in with email and password. Each team has boards, boards have columns, columns have cards. Team members can drag cards between columns. Only team members can see or edit a team's boards.

schema.title: Team Task Board
schema.originalPrompt: Build a task management app for small teams. Users sign in with email and password. Each team has boards, boards have columns, columns have cards. Team members can drag cards between columns. Only team members can see or edit a team's boards.

components.name: Board View
components.purpose: Shows columns and draggable cards for one board.

components.name: Login Page
components.purpose: Collects email and password and starts a session.

components.name: Team Switcher
components.purpose: Lets a user switch between teams they belong to.

components.name: Boards API
components.purpose: CRUD for boards, columns, and cards, scoped to team membership.

components.name: Auth Service
components.purpose: Issues and verifies session tokens on login.

components.name: boards table
components.purpose: Stores board id, team_id, and title.

components.name: cards table
components.purpose: Stores card id, column_id, text, and position.

components.name: team_members table
components.purpose: Maps user ids to team ids.

components.name: Team Membership Check
components.purpose: Rejects any board/card access from a user not on that team.

constraints.rawText: Only the backend may query the database; the UI must go through the Boards API.

prompt: Make something like Trello but different.

schema.title: Board App (Unspecified Differentiator)
schema.originalPrompt: Make something like Trello but different.

components.name: Board View
components.purpose: A generic board-style view; the prompt does not specify what makes it different from Trello.

components.name: Boards API
components.purpose: Generic CRUD for boards and cards, unscoped since no auth or team model was described.

components.name: boards table
components.purpose: Stores boards and cards; schema left generic given the prompt gives no domain specifics.

components.name: Forecast View
components.purpose: Shows current conditions and a short forecast for the user's location.

components.name: Weather API
components.purpose: Proxies a weather data provider and returns forecast data for a location.

prompt: A local, single-page calculator app. No login, no server, no saved history — it just runs entirely in the browser.

schema.title: Client-Only Calculator
schema.originalPrompt: A local, single-page calculator app. No login, no server, no saved history — it just runs entirely in the browser.

components.name: Calculator Widget
components.purpose: Renders a keypad and evaluates expressions entirely client-side.

constraints.rawText: The app must never make a network call; everything happens client-side.

prompt: A HIPAA-compliant patient records portal for a small clinic. Doctors, nurses, and front-desk staff have different access levels. Every view or edit of a patient record must be logged with who accessed it and when. Front-desk staff can see appointment info but never clinical notes.

schema.title: Patient Records Portal
schema.originalPrompt: A HIPAA-compliant patient records portal for a small clinic. Doctors, nurses, and front-desk staff have different access levels. Every view or edit of a patient record must be logged with who accessed it and when. Front-desk staff can see appointment info but never clinical notes.

components.name: Patient Record View
components.purpose: Shows a patient's record, with fields hidden or shown based on the viewer's role.

components.name: Appointment Desk View
components.purpose: Front-desk view showing scheduling info only, no clinical notes.

components.name: Patient Records API
components.purpose: Serves patient record reads/writes, gated by role.

components.name: Audit Log Service
components.purpose: Records every read or write of a patient record with actor, timestamp, and record id.

components.name: patient_records table
components.purpose: Stores clinical notes, diagnoses, and history, keyed by patient id.

components.name: audit_log table
components.purpose: Append-only log of every access to a patient record.

components.name: Role-Based Access Control
components.purpose: Enforces doctor/nurse/front-desk permission tiers on every record field.

components.name: Audit Interceptor
components.purpose: Ensures no record access path can bypass writing to the audit log.

constraints.rawText: Front-desk staff can see appointment info but never clinical notes.
Every view or edit of a patient record must be logged with who accessed it and when.

prompt: An online store where customers browse products, add them to a cart, and check out with a credit card. Admins can add and remove products and see order history.

schema.title: Online Store
schema.originalPrompt: An online store where customers browse products, add them to a cart, and check out with a credit card. Admins can add and remove products and see order history.

components.name: Product Catalog
components.purpose: Browsable, searchable list of products.

components.name: Cart & Checkout
components.purpose: Cart contents and a checkout flow that collects payment info.

components.name: Admin Product Panel
components.purpose: Lets an admin add, edit, and remove products.

components.name: Catalog API
components.purpose: Read endpoints for products; write endpoints restricted to admins.

components.name: Orders API
components.purpose: Creates orders from a cart and records payment status.

components.name: Payment Gateway Adapter
components.purpose: Talks to an external payment processor to charge a card.

components.name: products table
components.purpose: Stores product name, price, and stock count.

components.name: orders table
components.purpose: Stores order id, customer id, line items, and payment status.

components.name: Admin-Only Write Guard
components.purpose: Rejects product create/edit/delete from non-admin users.

constraints.rawText: Card details must never reach the frontend; only the Payment Gateway Adapter talks to the processor.

prompt: A site where anyone can post recipes and comment on other people's recipes. No sign-in required to browse, but you need an account to post.

schema.title: Recipe Sharing Site
schema.originalPrompt: A site where anyone can post recipes and comment on other people's recipes. No sign-in required to browse, but you need an account to post.

components.name: Recipe Feed
components.purpose: Public list of recipes, browsable without an account.

components.name: Recipe Editor
components.purpose: Form for posting a new recipe, requires sign-in.

components.name: Comment Thread
components.purpose: Shows and lets users add comments on a recipe.

components.name: Recipes API
components.purpose: Public reads, authenticated writes for recipes and comments.

components.name: Auth Service
components.purpose: Account creation and session handling for posting.

components.name: recipes table
components.purpose: Stores recipe title, ingredients, steps, and author id.

components.name: comments table
components.purpose: Stores comment text, recipe id, and author id.

components.name: Post-Requires-Account Guard
components.purpose: Rejects recipe or comment creation from an unauthenticated request.

prompt: An internal dashboard for our support team to look up customer accounts, see their subscription status, and issue refunds.

schema.title: Support Agent Dashboard
schema.originalPrompt: An internal dashboard for our support team to look up customer accounts, see their subscription status, and issue refunds.

components.name: Customer Lookup
components.purpose: Search customers by email or account id.

components.name: Refund Panel
components.purpose: Lets an agent issue a refund with a reason code.

components.name: Customer Lookup API
components.purpose: Read-only view of customer account and subscription status.

components.name: Refund API
components.purpose: Issues refunds through the billing provider and logs the reason.

components.name: refund_log table
components.purpose: Records every refund with agent id, amount, and reason.

components.name: Internal-Only Guard
components.purpose: Rejects any request not from an authenticated support agent.

constraints.rawText: Agents can see subscription status but never raw card numbers.

prompt: A real-time chat app with rooms. Messages should show up for everyone in the room instantly, without refreshing.

schema.title: Realtime Chat Rooms
schema.originalPrompt: A real-time chat app with rooms. Messages should show up for everyone in the room instantly, without refreshing.

components.name: Chat Room View
components.purpose: Shows a live-updating message list and an input box for a room.

components.name: Realtime Message Service
components.purpose: Broadcasts new messages to every client connected to a room over a persistent connection.

components.name: messages table
components.purpose: Stores message text, room id, sender id, and timestamp.

prompt: A personal finance app that connects to my bank account, pulls in transactions automatically, and lets me tag them into budget categories.

schema.title: Personal Finance Tracker
schema.originalPrompt: A personal finance app that connects to my bank account, pulls in transactions automatically, and lets me tag them into budget categories.

components.name: Transaction List
components.purpose: Shows synced transactions and lets the user assign a category.

components.name: Budget Overview
components.purpose: Summarises spending per category against a monthly budget.

components.name: Bank Sync Service
components.purpose: Pulls transactions from a bank-linking provider on a schedule.

components.name: Categorisation API
components.purpose: Stores and updates category tags on transactions.

components.name: transactions table
components.purpose: Stores synced transaction amount, merchant, date, and category.

components.name: bank_credentials table
components.purpose: Stores encrypted bank-link tokens, never raw bank passwords.

components.name: Credential Encryption
components.purpose: Bank-link tokens are encrypted at rest and never logged.

constraints.rawText: The frontend must never see raw bank credentials or tokens, only synced transaction data.

prompt: My personal portfolio site. Just a few pages about me, my projects, and a contact form that emails me.

schema.title: Personal Portfolio Site
schema.originalPrompt: My personal portfolio site. Just a few pages about me, my projects, and a contact form that emails me.

components.name: About/Projects Pages
components.purpose: Static pages describing the author and their projects.

components.name: Contact Form
components.purpose: Collects a message and sends it by email; the only non-static part of the site.

components.name: Contact Form Handler
components.purpose: Receives the contact form submission and sends it as an email.

prompt: A dashboard for monitoring temperature sensors across several warehouses. Each sensor pushes a reading every minute. Devices must authenticate with an API key, and the dashboard should alert when a sensor goes offline or reports an out-of-range value.

schema.title: IoT Sensor Dashboard
schema.originalPrompt: A dashboard for monitoring temperature sensors across several warehouses. Each sensor pushes a reading every minute. Devices must authenticate with an API key, and the dashboard should alert when a sensor goes offline or reports an out-of-range value.

components.name: Sensor Dashboard
components.purpose: Live grid of sensors per warehouse, with alert banners.

components.name: Ingest API
components.purpose: Accepts sensor readings, authenticated by device API key.

components.name: Alerting Service
components.purpose: Watches for missed heartbeats or out-of-range readings and raises alerts.

components.name: readings table
components.purpose: Stores sensor id, warehouse id, value, and timestamp.

components.name: devices table
components.purpose: Stores device id, warehouse id, and hashed API key.

components.name: Device API Key Check
components.purpose: Rejects any ingested reading whose API key does not match a registered device.

constraints.rawText: Devices must authenticate with an API key before any reading is accepted.
